assessment: This study reports the discovery of EGFR related tyrosine kinase inhibitors as agents that could potentially be repurposed to counteract metabolic disturbances arising from insulin resistance. The authors have used a computational approach to define a gene signature, which was then inputted to identify 130 compounds that interacted with pathways involved in insulin resistance. Important clinical implications may eventually follow from these studies.
